title: Lovely Robot: Legacy
description: The current-generation robot companion mod. Craft a robot, name her, bring her along — and watch what changes when you actually spend time together. Several robot types, 16 colours each, a levelling system, combat specialisations, and a protection mechanic
body:
## Overview Lovely Robot: Legacy is the current-generation companion mod. Craft a robot, give her a name, bring her along — and watch what happens when you actually spend time together. Several robot types. Sixteen colours each. A levelling system, combat specialisations, and a protection mechanic that scales with the bond you've built. Legacy is the version most players know, now rebuilt from the ground up on a clean multi-loader foundation. It's vanilla-friendly, but it rewards players who go deep. ---

⚠️ NOTICE — Please read before installing

This mod requires HZLib, LovelyLib & GeckoLib to work!

--- ## Robot Types Each type has a distinct personality, stat profile, and combat role. | Robot | Role | Highlight | |-------|------|-----------| | Vanilla | All-rounder | Balanced starter companion | | Bunny | Speed | Fastest movement, great for exploration | | Bunny2 | Speed / Combat | Bunny with more bite | | Bunny3 | Speed / Pastel | Bunny in a softer colour palette | | Honey | Support | Resource management and automation | | Dragon | Heavy Combat | Highest damage, intimidation aura | | Neko | Agile Combat | High attack speed, pounce, night vision | | Kitsune | Support / Buff | Fox blessings, tail progression up to 9 tails | All types are available in **16 dye colours**. --- ## Features - **Levelling system** — robots gain XP in the field and level up to type-specific caps (80–150) - **Named robots level faster** — a small XP bonus once you give your robot a name - **Protection system** — damage type resistance scales with level and integrates with enchantments - **Combat specialisations** — each robot type has unique abilities and combat patterns - **Smart Core Retrieval** — if your robot dies nearby, her core flies back to your inventory automatically; glowing outline if she's out of range - **Ctrl+Shift+Empty Hand pickup** — convert your robot back to a spawn item without losing any data - **Health persistence** — robot health is preserved across world reloads - **Sitting animations** — dynamic hitbox, random delay transitions, vehicle sitting support (boats, minecarts, horses) - **Core glow** — colour-coded team scoreboard integration, 16 colours - **Base Defense Scan** — four patrol patterns (FULL_SCAN, DOUBLE_SWEEP, QUADRANT_CHECK, RANDOM_POINTS) - **Commands** — `/llovely` with list, summon, teleport, stats, config --- ## Dependencies - **LovelyLib** (required) - **HZLib** (required) --- ## Compatibility | Minecraft | Fabric | Forge | NeoForge | |-----------|--------|-------|----------| | 1.21.1 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | 1.20.1 | Planned | Planned | — | | 1.19.4 | Planned | Planned | — | | 1.19.2 | Planned | Planned | — | | 1.18.2 | Planned | Planned | — | | 1.17.1 | Planned | Planned | — | | 1.16.5 | Planned | Planned | — | | 1.12.2 | — | Planned | — | | 1.7.10 | — | Planned | — | Implementation for 1.21.1 is in progress. Broad version support (back to 1.7.10) is the long-term target. --- ## Conversion - Robots from the original Lovely Robot (1.12.2) can be converted to Legacy saves. - Legacy and Tribute can convert between each other. - Legacy saves can be converted to Reboot. Reboot saves cannot convert back. --- ## Links - Source: [GitHub — heria-zone](https://github.com/heria-zone) - Issues: GitHub Issues - Lovely Robot: Tribute — for the original four-robot experience - Lovely Robot: Reboot — the ambitious long-term vision (in development) --- ## Credits and License **Original mod:** [Lovely Robot](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/lovelyrobot) by **lilacx02** **Bedrock addon reference:** [Lovely Robots (Bedrock)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft-bedrock/addons/lovelyrobots) by **Virtualblack867 & D Flog Flag** The textures, models, and art assets used in this mod are sourced from the original works above and are licensed under the **MIT License**. You are free to use, copy, modify, and distribute them with attribution. **All code** — including the entity framework, AI systems, levelling and protection mechanics, multi-loader architecture, and the HZLib / LovelyLib libraries — was written from the ground up by **MSymbios / Heria Zone** and is All Rights Reserved. ### How This Differs from the Original The original Lovely Robot by lilacx02 was a 1.12.2 Forge mod with four robot types and basic companion behaviour. Lovely Robot: Legacy is a full rebuild for modern Minecraft that adds: - Three additional robot types (Dragon, Neko, Kitsune) - 16-colour dye palette across all types - Levelling system with type-specific caps - Protection system with damage type resistance and enchantment integration - Smart Core Retrieval on death - Base defense scan with four patrol patterns - Multi-loader support (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge) - Cross-version save migration from 1.12.2 originals The robots look like the originals because that was the intent — to continue and expand lilacx02's work. The code that makes them behave is new.
